## Description
Briefly describe the change and the problem it solves.

## Related Issue
Closes #ISSUE_NUMBER (if applicable)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking)
- [ ] Breaking change (requires migration or reconfiguration)
- [ ] Refactor (no functional change)
- [ ] Documentation only
- [ ] Build / CI / Packaging

## Testing
- [ ] Unit tests added / updated
- [ ] Integration tests added / updated
- [ ] All existing tests pass (`pytest tests/`)
- [ ] Tested in portable mode
- [ ] Tested in installed mode

## Quality
- [ ] No lint errors (`ruff check .`)
- [ ] Formatted with project style (`ruff format .`)
- [ ] Type hints present and valid
- [ ] No temporary / debug files included
- [ ] No secrets or credentials committed

## Governance
- [ ] Commit messages follow [semantic conventions](COMMIT_CONVENTIONS.md)
- [ ] Branch name follows governance rules (if feature branch)
- [ ] CHANGELOG or release notes updated (if user-facing)

## Deployment Impact
- [ ] Requires migration
- [ ] Changes data directory layout
- [ ] Changes configuration schema
- [ ] Adds new dependencies
- [ ] No deployment impact

## Additional Notes
Any caveats, design decisions, or follow-up work.
